executiveSummary: GM0384's code, Diemen name, Noord-Holland province, Amsterdam-Amstelland safety-region membership, 2025 CBS control total, eight districts, 37 neighbourhoods and one BAG place are coherent. Neighbourhood rows sum to 33,215 residents, only 13 below the official 33,228 (-0.039%), and unavailable source fields remain null. All ten canonical exercises run deterministically at T+0/6/12/24/48/72 across all eight services; zero-intensity, finite-bound, reconciliation, cumulative-burden, causal-ledger, recovery-guard and layer-invariance checks pass. Release nevertheless requires correction. Coastal T+24 creates internal normalized inundation stress 1.182148, 8,519 affected people-equivalent and ultimately 839,711.712 attributable person-hours without selecting an IJmeer/Markermeer or Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal boundary condition, named defence state, breach/overflow, connected footprint, arrival or dewatering path. Pluvial, coastal, heat and wildfire use the same complete neighbourhood order; Diemer Vijfhoek, with zero registered residents, leads all four, while a diagnostic ignition placed in Gemeenschapspolder still ranks that source neighbourhood 17th of 37. Every lifeline copies the same five A1/A9/Hartveldseweg route IDs despite no physical utility evidence, while known rail/metro/tram, tunnel, high-voltage and regional-water dependencies remain context only. Zero locally assigned HWH water assets, RWS stations or acute-care locations are coverage/query outcomes, not absence or safety. No unavailable or security-sensitive physical utility topology, live state, capacity, backup or restoration promise is fabricated.

evidenceSources.title: Kerncijfers wijken en buurten 2025, table 86165NED, OData API
supports: The fresh official GM0384 row gives Diemen, 33,228 residents, density 2,781 per square kilometre, 5,346 residents aged 65+ (16.1%) and 7,857 one-person households.

The 37 generated neighbourhood rows sum to 33,215 residents (-13, -0.039%), 16,880 households and 5,335 residents aged 65+; separately rounded small-area values are not silently rewritten to the municipality controls.

The OData service is machine-readable under CC BY 4.0. CBS labels this a 2025 table with quarterly additions as variables become available; randomized rounding, suppression and missing values are not zero.

Simulation role is official demographic/context and allocation denominator only. Registered residence is not timestamped presence at schools, stations, workplaces, care sites, roads or an incident footprint.

evidenceSources.title: CBS Gebiedsindelingen 2025 non-generalized geometry and national settlement/transport reference APIs
evidenceSources.edition: 2025 boundary; current generated BAG, BRT, NWB, ProRail and GTFS reference editions
supports: Fresh full-resolution GM0384 feature 8e866ce7-3812-5b29-bf8c-16159780f8d7 has two MultiPolygon components, two rings and 3,030 positions. The generated overview has one component/ring and 88 positions, contains its centre, and drops a small eastern component of about 0.042 square kilometres.

The bundle contains eight districts, 37 neighbourhoods and BAG place Diemen. BRT supplies Diemen, Over-Diemen and Stammerdijk; Diemen and Diemen Zuid ProRail stations and 37 GTFS stop areas cover rail, metro, tram and bus reference context.

Five logical border links use A1/A9 between Amsterdam, Diemen and Gooise Meren plus Hartveldseweg toward Amsterdam. Their nominal capacities 260/150 are scenario units, not observed vehicle, passenger, emergency or goods throughput.

CBS boundary OGC is half-yearly/CC BY 4.0; BAG is daily/Public Domain Mark; BRT is CC BY 4.0; NWB OGC/download is monthly/CC0 1.0; ProRail reference geometry is manually refreshed/CC0 1.0. The generated OVapi GTFS feed is best effort/free-use with no SLA. These products are reference geography, not current passability or utility topology.

evidenceSources.title: Programma Klimaatadaptatie 2024-2028 and municipal sewer/water implementation reporting
supports: The adopted programme uses a 120 mm/hour design objective split into 90 mm storage and 30 mm discharge, explicitly selects deep-polder storage, and identifies local maps and bottlenecks. It is a five-year policy/design standard, not a current observation or hydraulic event.

The official sewer/water budget page at https://programmabegroting2025.financielestukken.diemen.nl/paragrafen/onderhoud-kapitaalgoederen/riolering-en-stedelijk-water states pumps are monitored and alarmed by telemetry, groundwater/rain are measured automatically, and a hydraulic model covers the mixed sewer in Diemen Centrum; it also names works in Vlindertuin, Scheepskwartier and Oosterringvaart.

The 2024 accounts at https://jaarrekening2024.financielestukken.diemen.nl/paragrafen/duurzaamheid/jaarprogramma-duurzaamheid-2024/3.-naar-een-gezonde-leefomgeving say four of the then 35 neighbourhoods met Diemen's water-overload standards. That older denominator must not be conflated with the current 37-neighbourhood CBS edition.

These fixed pages/PDF supply locally falsifiable mechanism and policy context but no licensed raw raster/API, live pump state, sewer topology, connected inundation footprint or contractual refresh cadence; their simulation role is validation and requirements discovery only.

evidenceSources.title: Regionaal Risicoprofiel Amsterdam-Amstelland 2025-2028, verdieping
supports: VRAA's pluvial scenario is 120 mm in one to three hours with a 90 mm/hour peak and saturated ground; it identifies the eastern region including Diemen as especially affected, with water up to about 50 cm, lower roads/tunnels becoming impassable, sewer overflow and pump/power interaction.

For this region, failure of a polder or regional defence is more probable than a primary-sea-defence failure. VRAA cites the November 2023 combination of high canal/Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal level, rainfall and IJmuiden pumping disruption as relevant system context.

VRAA's electricity scenario uses the Diemen high-voltage station and records that a 2016 substation fire affected about 23,000 households in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, Diemen and De Ronde Venen; consequences can stop rail, tram, metro, traffic lights, lifts, telecom, heating and payments.

The risk profile treats large nature fire as relatively limited because the region lacks large heath, peat, dune or park complexes, while noting future increase. It separately identifies hazardous-material rail risk near Diemen Zuid; that hazard is outside the ten canonical presets and must not be silently mapped to another scenario. This fixed expert/planning PDF has no raw API, open-data licence or live cadence.

evidenceSources.title: Diemen emergency barrier, Stammerdijk and Diemerzeedijk official defence context
evidenceSources.edition: Current project and legal-context pages inspected 2 September 2026
supports: The normally open emergency gates at Het Nieuwe Diep and De Diem can isolate the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal from De Diem and the Amstellandboezem. AGV describes investigations in 2025-2026, design toward the end of 2026 and works expected in the second half of 2027; planned maintenance is not evidence of current failure.

AGV's Stammerdijk page and Q&A at https://www.agv.nl/werk-in-uitvoering/dijkverbetering-stammerdijk/ and https://www.agv.nl/werk-in-uitvoering/dijkverbetering-stammerdijk/qa/ say the defence along the Gaasp protects the polder and is too low in places. A standards gap is not a selected breach, overflow or warning.

The official Diemerzeedijk page at https://www.agv.nl/recreatie/watererfgoed/dijken/diemerzeedijk/ describes roughly seven kilometres of primary defence along the IJmeer/Markermeer context. The legal legger portal at https://www.agv.nl/onze-taken/legger/ maps defences and principal waters but omits some small ditches.

The public pages/ArcGIS viewer give legal and project context, not a stable licensed raw-data contract, current gate/dike state, connected flood footprint, capacity, backup, recession or repair time. Simulation must select a named scenario and state rather than infer failure from maintenance.

evidenceSources.title: AGV Climate Atlas REST catalogue and WMS stress-test layers
evidenceSources.edition: Public catalogue inspected 2 September 2026; layer-specific 2013-2020 source editions
supports: The public REST catalogue exposes 45 map themes and gives WMS URLs, layer identifiers, legends and GetFeatureInfo capability across the AGV area. The 90 mm/one-hour depth metadata at https://agv.klimaatmonitor.net/api/maplayers/1d17b512-e547-4fe7-86fd-f63ca3d8a902/ points to https://demo.lizard.net/wms/ layer extern:nl:agv:waterdepth_90mm_20171231_mask; it is static modeled context, not current rainfall or inundation.

Road-passability metadata at https://agv.klimaatmonitor.net/api/maplayers/32dfc302-db14-46a4-84d0-01a7ee268d7d/ classifies a 90 mm event as passable, emergency-only or impassable. Primary- and regional-defence maximum-depth maps at https://agv.klimaatmonitor.net/api/maplayers/68bddab2-4a31-4f3a-8d74-d9773844cd2e/ and https://agv.klimaatmonitor.net/api/maplayers/4dc53150-5887-4ebe-9b6b-e7e28fc6cbd5/ combine maxima from mutually exclusive breach cases; the regional source is older/incomplete.

Heat PET metadata at https://agv.klimaatmonitor.net/api/maplayers/1dfc25b6-1671-4f12-9842-bb440d0dcb24/ is based on a warm 1 July 2015 reference day and older AHN/land-cover inputs, updated 7 June 2020. It cannot validate current conditions or precise T+72 people affected.

The API/WMS is integration-ready for non-causal display and visual validation, but public raster download may require owner permission and the catalogue supplies no standard reuse licence or contractual refresh cadence. Numeric causal use requires permission plus source cell size, units, NoData, edition/scenario/effective time and uncertainty.

evidenceSources.title: Gaasperdammertunnel operational context and Diemerbos/Gemeenschapspolder nature context
evidenceSources.edition: Current official reference pages inspected 2 September 2026
supports: Rijkswaterstaat describes the Gaasperdammertunnel as a three-kilometre, five-tube A9 tunnel on the Holendrecht-Diemen corridor with an emergency protocol. It is an important regional access dependency, but this reference page is not live passability, traffic capacity or T+72 availability.

NWB is the integration-ready national road-topology source (monthly, CC0 1.0), while NDW DATEX II situations are timestamped traffic observations/plans commonly carrying up to 72-hour validity and generally CC0 unless the dataset states otherwise. A zero GM0384 situation query is unknown/open-state evidence only at the query time, never guaranteed continuity.

Staatsbosbeheer's official Gaasp en Diem page at https://www.staatsbosbeheer.nl/uit-in-de-natuur/locaties/gaasp-en-diem identifies Diemerbos in the former Gemeenschapspolder, with recreational forest in the west and wetter nature in the east. Its wet-forest pilot page at https://www.staatsbosbeheer.nl/wat-we-doen/werk-in-uitvoering/gaasp-en-diem-vernatten-bos-diemerscheg covers 2023-2027.

These fixed operator/manager pages validate transport and nature mechanisms only. They do not provide a live tunnel state, ignition, perimeter, fuel moisture, smoke plume, response time or guarantee; the nature pages have no standard machine API, reuse licence or contractual cadence.

evidenceSources.publisher: Liander / Stichting Mijn Aansluiting / Rijkswaterstaat / DUO / RDI / RIVM / NDW
evidenceSources.title: Machine-readable provider, power, water, education, antenna, care and traffic public context
supports: Liander's CC BY 4.0 ArcGIS FeatureServer is machine-queryable and a full-boundary query of the high-voltage-station layer returns OS VENSERWEG in Diemen, classified 150 kV/10 kV. The dataset has provider/item edit timestamps but no contractual update cadence and does not publish load flow, switching, capacity, exposure, backup or restoration.

Liander's current outage layer at https://services1.arcgis.com/v6W5HAVrpgSg3vts/ArcGIS/rest/services/IStoringen_Productie_V7/FeatureServer/0 is CC BY 4.0, cacheable for about 30 seconds, and carries report time, status and affected-customer band for roughly the past 12 months. A query at audit time found no unresolved Diemen row; that timestamped snapshot is not future T+72 availability.

The Public Domain Mijn Aansluiting WMS/WFS at https://public.geodata.mijnaansluiting.nl/geoserver/mijnaansluiting_open/ows assigns Liander electricity/gas, Waternet drinking water and Ziggo media at the municipal centre with provider-specific 2025/2026 timestamps and no drainage polygon. Territories are not cables, pipes, connectivity, coverage, state or capacity.

Generated non-causal context assigns 16 DUO education locations, 50 RDI antenna-installation records, zero RIVM acute-care points, zero RWS Waterinfo stations, zero HWH water assets and zero current NDW situations to GM0384. DUO is daily around 06:15 under attribution terms; RIVM acute-care v1.1 is CC0 and published 3 July 2026; Waterinfo is generally ten-minute/CC0/non-mission-critical; HWH IMWA is weekly/CC BY-SA 4.0 while DAMO contributor cadence varies. RDI's live WFS licence/cadence is unstated. Every zero remains a source/query coverage result, not absence, clean/open state or safety.

scenarioMatrix.summary: All ten canonical scenarios execute at all six mandatory checkpoints for all eight services.
notes: MUNICIPALITY_AUDIT_CODE=GM0384 pnpm audit:model passed one file/two focused coverage tests in 34.48 seconds (34.30 seconds test time) for ten presets, T+0/6/12/24/48/72 and power/water/drainage/gas/telecom/mobility/facilities/supply.

At 1440x1000, headless Chromium selected Diemen, coastal flood, T+24, all 11 map modes and Gemeenschapspolder with no console/page/same-origin response errors; initial render was 516 ms, municipality selection 375 ms, scenario 940 ms, checkpoint 1,306 ms and neighbourhood click 478 ms in that run. spatialPlausibility.summary: Generic distance/seed allocation creates precise local ranks that do not respond to Diemen's hazard-specific surfaces or a controlled local source.
notes: Pluvial, coastal, heat and wildfire have the exact same complete 37-neighbourhood T+24 order. Diemer Vijfhoek (population zero), Overdiemen (10) and Holland Park West (195) lead each; this is not evidence of hazard-specific exposure.

With a diagnostic wildfire ignition at Gemeenschapspolder's representative point [4.998458069888085, 52.32777894943194], municipal direct fire peaks 0.656973 at T+11, yet Gemeenschapspolder ranks 17th and Diemer Vijfhoek remains first.
Official municipality/VRAA/AGV evidence supplies locally distinct pluvial, defence, heat and nature mechanisms, but no layer is consumed to derive the ranks.

The omitted official polygon component and use of representative points add further uncertainty; neighbourhood precision is not releasable until hazard-specific geometry and NoData contracts are enforced.

serviceDependencies.summary: All eight services share the same five road links despite sector-specific Diemen dependencies and unavailable physical topology.
notes: A1/A9/Hartveldseweg IDs and nominal capacities are identical for power, water, drainage, gas, telecom, mobility, facilities and supply.

VRAA and Liander identify a real Diemen high-voltage dependency; AGV/municipality identify controlled water and sewer systems; ProRail/GTFS/RWS identify mode-specific access. None supports road-shaped electricity, water, drainage, gas, telecom or facility transfer.
At compound T+24 all eight services are impaired and facilities are limiting, but there is no local facility occupancy/capacity, utility topology, backup, stocks, staffing or restoration evidence.
Physical infrastructure can be unavailable or security-sensitive. The honest fallback is Unknown or a clearly labeled non-spatial synthetic index, not operator-attributed precision.

causalTrace.summary: Municipality, hazard, service-dependency and route ledgers close and identify modeled rather than empirical attribution.
notes: The focused contract verifies ledger closure, deterministic counterfactuals and contribution identities for all scenarios/services/checkpoints.
The trace states dimension shares and system-pressure weights are model assumptions rather than empirical causal estimates, and distinguishes intermunicipal transfers from event-attributable burden.

River T+24/T+72 direct severity and person-hours are zero while 1,657/3,621 people-equivalent remain under indirect proxy-network pressure; this is internally consistent but must remain visibly indirect/non-event-attributable.
The explanation cannot repair unsupported physical scenario selection, local ranking or service topology.

recovery72h.summary: Recovery guards behave internally, but local recovery timing cannot be validated without event, infrastructure and operator state.
notes: At compound T+72 internal inundation stress remains 0.439429 with cyber severity 0.048636, 23,383 affected, 1,073,312.075 cumulative person-hours and zero recovery for all services, confirming the sustained-water repair guard.
Coastal T+72 forcing is zero but 885 remain affected, cumulative burden reaches 839,711.712, water availability is 0.570470 and recovery spans 0.521829-0.948862.

Storm, pluvial, winter and wildfire forcing clear by T+72 and recovery progresses within bounds; heat remains active but affected falls to zero. These are scenario mechanics, not locally observed restoration promises.
No selected defence/pump/utility/facility state, crew access, backup, depletion, recession/dewatering or operator repair distribution supports the precise T+72 values.

findings.summary: Generated identity, safety-region membership, demographic controls and settlement structure are coherent.
findings.evidence: CBS gives 33,228 residents; 37 neighbourhood rows sum to 33,215 (-0.039%) and reconcile without overwriting observations. Code, name, province, safety region, BAG place and BRT labels agree.
findings.action: Retain source editions, randomized-rounding/suppression rules, published-versus-allocated totals and null semantics on every refresh.

findings.summary: The generalized overview drops one small official eastern polygon component.
findings.evidence: Fresh PDOK non-generalized geometry has two components/two rings/3,030 positions; the generated one-component 88-position overview omits about 0.042 square kilometres. The contents were not guessed, but loss can alter border, water and asset association.
findings.action: Use the full-resolution annual geometry for analytical intersections and retain the compact outline only for display/selection.

findings.summary: Unavailable statistics and zero public-context matches are treated as unknown rather than false zero or safe state.
findings.evidence: Sparse CBS fields remain null. UI/context inspection identifies zero HWH assets, Waterinfo stations, acute-care points and current NDW situations as no local match/coverage, while official AGV pages demonstrate local water systems. Provider absence likewise remains unknown.
findings.action: Keep source coverage, query/effective time, quality, suppression and NoData semantics through ingestion, aggregation, simulation eligibility and UI rendering.

findings.summary: A generic coastal screen produces precise Diemen inundation and first-72-hour impacts without an event or defence-state contract.
findings.evidence: Coastal T+24 produces severity 0.357323, internal normalized inundation stress 1.182148, 8,519 affected and cumulative burden 271,884.883; T+72 still has 885 affected and 839,711.712 person-hours. No IJmeer/Markermeer or canal level, surge/tide, named Diemerzeedijk/emergency-gate/boezem defence state, breach/overflow, connected footprint, arrival, recession or dewatering path is selected. AGV maintenance/standards pages are not failure evidence.
findings.action: Require an AGV/Rijkswaterstaat-approved named, versioned hydraulic event and defence state before direct local impact is releasable; otherwise show Unknown and keep the distance screen diagnostic only.

findings.summary: One source-insensitive neighbourhood order is reused across physically unrelated hazards.
findings.evidence: Pluvial, coastal, heat and wildfire share the exact complete 37-row order: zero-population Diemer Vijfhoek first, Overdiemen second and Holland Park West third. Municipal/VRAA/AGV sources distinguish rainfall storage/sewers, defence floods and PET heat, yet none drives local allocation.
findings.action: Replace the shared seed with hazard-specific versioned surfaces/covariates and suppress hotspot precision until scenario, unit, cell size, NoData, edition/effective time, licence and uncertainty are recorded.

findings.summary: Neighbourhood wildfire allocation does not follow a controlled source in Diemerbos/Gemeenschapspolder.
findings.evidence: The canonical wildfire is remote smoke with direct flame zero and peaks at T+11 severity 0.138690/smoke 0.338590. When the source is deliberately placed at Gemeenschapspolder's representative point, municipal direct fire peaks 0.656973 but the source neighbourhood ranks 17th while Diemer Vijfhoek remains first. Staatsbosbeheer verifies Diemerbos/Gemeenschapspolder context; VRAA says large nature fire is limited, not impossible.
findings.action: Require source/perimeter proximity and governed vegetation/fuel/moisture inputs for direct fire. Keep remote smoke separate and label absence of an ignition/perimeter as Unknown, not no risk.

findings.summary: The national overlay assigns zero water assets despite locally published defences and monitored urban-water systems.
findings.evidence: The generated HWH count is zero, while AGV identifies Diemerzeedijk, Stammerdijk, emergency gates and legal water features and the municipality describes telemetry, rainfall/groundwater monitoring and a sewer hydraulic model. Zero Waterinfo points likewise means no assigned station, not a zero water level.
findings.action: Reconcile HWH completeness with an AGV-authorized legal export, preserve dataset/effective time and NoData, and never derive topology, operating state or safety from object counts.

findings.summary: The same five roads are copied into all eight lifelines despite no physical utility or facility evidence.
findings.evidence: Power, water, drainage, gas, telecom, mobility, facilities and supply all use identical A1/A9/Hartveldseweg route IDs and nominal capacities. NWB supports road geometry only. Liander/AGV/VRAA show sector-specific power and water mechanisms; ProRail/GTFS/RWS show rail, metro, tram and tunnel dependencies, not road-shaped utility transfer.
findings.action: Restrict NWB/NDW/rail/transit routes to mobility and evidenced supply dependencies. Obtain safe sector-specific aggregate service interfaces; where topology is unavailable/security-sensitive, use Unknown or transparent non-spatial synthetic indices without operator attribution.

findings.summary: Wind, rain, heat/drought, winter, cyber, earthquake, smoke and compound values are generic exercises rather than event-valid observations or forecasts.
findings.evidence: No named KNMI replay, cyber target, earthquake, wildfire ignition/perimeter or local hydraulic event is selected. Earthquake peaks at T+2.25 severity 0.026543 and 0.008494 g; canonical wildfire is smoke-only locally. River direct zero is scoped only to Rhine/Meuse/IJssel and does not cover Diemen's canal/boezem/polder pathways. The VRAA hazardous-material rail scenario is outside the canonical ten.
findings.action: Retain explicit synthetic/derived/indirect/scoped labels, source and effective time. Bind observed replay only to event-valid data and never convert absent observations, warnings or targets to zero/safe.

findings.summary: The full numerical, checkpoint, allocation, causal-ledger and sustained-flood contract passes for GM0384.
findings.evidence: Focused gates cover ten presets, six checkpoints and eight services. Values are finite/deterministic, zero intensity is exact, local/service totals reconcile, ledgers close, burden is monotone, layer selection is invariant and standing water blocks repair. Browser inspection exposes normalized inundation stress, derived-screening evidence, no-data semantics and Why this state.
findings.action: Keep GM0384 and national ALL coverage in regression and add event-selection, hazard-specific spatial/source, full-boundary, water NoData and service-route-separation assertions.

corrections.summary: Replace the common neighbourhood seed with hazard-specific Diemen surfaces and a source-responsive fire/smoke contract.
corrections.validation: Use AGV Climate Atlas public REST/WMS 90-mm water-depth and road-passability layers (regional, static Lizard 2017-era model, map-scale WMS/GetFeatureInfo; reuse/download/cell/NoData contract incomplete) and PET heat layer (regional, 1 July 2015 reference, updated 2020; same licence caveat) for non-causal visual checks. KNMI Data Platform radar/nowcast/observations are national/radar-domain, product-versioned, typically 5-/10-minute and CC BY 4.0 for named weather replays; PDOK AHN/BGT provide national elevation/topography context under CC0/Public Domain Mark with dataset-specific acquisition/daily editions, not impacts. Staatsbosbeheer supplies fixed land-manager context for Diemerbos/Gemeenschapspolder but no live licensed fuel/ignition API. Before numeric ingestion record publisher, layer/version, unit, cell size, NoData, scenario/effective/observation time, cadence, licence and uncertainty. Tests must reject identical complete ranks across unrelated hazards and require source proximity for direct fire while modeling smoke separately.

corrections.summary: Separate Diemen mobility/supply connectivity from electricity, water, drainage, gas, telecom and facility dependencies.
corrections.validation: Use RWS NWB OGC/download for national road topology (monthly, CC0 1.0), NDW DATEX II for timestamped current/planned situations (national, commonly near-real-time with up-to-72-hour validity, generally CC0 unless stated), ProRail CC0 station/reference data (national, manually refreshed) and the generated OVapi GTFS (national schedule/reference, best effort/free-use/no SLA) for mobility and evidenced supply only. Record mode, direction, event/effective time, validity, passability, capacity unit, licence and NoData; absent NDW/GTFS state remains Unknown. Use Liander's CC BY 4.0 substation/outage services and AGV/municipal water context non-causally unless operators release safe aggregate service-area, customers-served, continuity/backup band and restoration interfaces. Assert A1/A9/Hartveldseweg cannot appear in power, water, drainage, gas, telecom or facilities without separate evidence. Physical topology that is unavailable/security-sensitive remains Unknown or a labeled synthetic non-spatial index.

corrections.summary: Reconcile public Diemen context and full geometry without turning provider/register/no-match data into causal state.
corrections.validation: Retain the PDOK/CBS 2025 two-component geometry for analytical association (national municipality coverage, half-yearly, CC BY 4.0) and the compact 88-point version only for rendering. Reconcile HWH weekly IMWA/variable DAMO CC BY-SA 4.0 with AGV-authorized exports; zero still means no match/coverage. Mijn Aansluiting WFS https://public.geodata.mijnaansluiting.nl/geoserver/mijnaansluiting_open/ows is national Public Domain provider-area context with provider-specific timestamps, not topology. Liander electricity/outage ArcGIS is regional-provider CC BY 4.0 with live/item timestamps but no contractual cadence; DUO is national daily around 06:15 under attribution terms; RIVM acute-care v1.1 is national CC0/fixed 3 July 2026 questionnaire context; RDI live WFS licence/cadence is unstated. Store source coverage, spatial resolution, query/observation/effective time, edition, cadence, licence, quality and NoData. Keep all as official context/observed snapshot unless an explicit scenario adapter consumes an event-valid field; never project current observations to T+72.

residualLimitations: This is an audit of a deterministic first-72-hour exercise model, not a warning, forecast, hydraulic assessment, evacuation plan, outage statement or operator commitment.
CBS 2025 neighbourhood values are randomized/rounded/suppressed and sums need not equal the municipality total; null statistics and zero public-context matches remain unknown, not zero.
Registered residents do not equal people present at stations, schools, workplaces, care sites, roads, Diemerbos, industrial areas or events; no authoritative timestamped occupancy is consumed.
The 88-position overview is suitable for map selection, not hydraulic, waterbody, defence, road, raster, catchment or asset intersection; use the official 3,030-position two-component geometry.

Municipal climate policy, VRAA risk scenarios, AGV defence/project context and climate-atlas stress tests are planning/modelled evidence, not current observations, adopted failures or exact consequences.
AGV's atlas/legger do not expose a complete standard-licence, raw-download, cell-size, NoData and contractual-refresh package for causal calibration; permission and metadata remain prerequisites.
AGV and municipal pages identify water/defence/sewer controls but not current connected catchment, gate/pump/defence state, capacity, backup, failure, inundation/dewatering path or restoration.

NWB roads, NDW situations, ProRail stations, GTFS stops, provider territories, antennas, education and acute-care registers do not establish live continuity, occupancy, connectivity, capacity, backup or repair.
Liander's public high-voltage/substation and current-outage data are useful context/snapshots but do not expose flow, switching, local dependency, asset vulnerability, backup or T+72 restoration.

No complete public physical electricity, drinking-water, wastewater, gas, telecom, facility, fuel, stock, staffing, backup, repair or restoration topology is consumed; unavailable/security-sensitive gaps remain unknown or explicitly synthetic.

The Rhine/Meuse/IJssel preset's exact direct zero is scope-specific and does not mean no IJmeer/Markermeer, Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, Gaasp, boezem, polder, rainfall, groundwater or regional-water pathway.
Earthquake, remote smoke and cyber are exercises without a selected local event/target; current Liander, Waterinfo, NDW or KNMI observations are not aligned to the scenario clock.

Hazardous-material transport near Diemen Zuid, evacuation, acute-care referral, tunnel/rail/metro operations, cross-boundary water/service catchments and recovery after T+72 remain outside locally validated scope.
provinceReviewFlags: GM0384-FLOOD-001 — AGV, Rijkswaterstaat/WMCN, Province Noord-Holland, VRAA and Diemen should require a named, versioned, defence-aware IJmeer/Markermeer/canal/boezem event and connected footprint before direct inundation/exposure is releasable.

GM0384-SPATIAL-SEED-001 — AGV, Province Noord-Holland and municipality should supply governed hazard-specific surfaces with scenario, unit, resolution, NoData, edition/effective time and licence and reject the shared 37-neighbourhood order.

GM0384-WILDFIRE-001 — VRAA, Staatsbosbeheer and municipality should require source/perimeter-responsive fire allocation and separately governed smoke; absence of a selected ignition is Unknown rather than no risk.
GM0384-WATER-CONTEXT-001 — AGV/HWH/Rijkswaterstaat should reconcile zero national asset/station assignment without inferring absent infrastructure, zero level or safety.

GM0384-NETWORK-001 — RWS/NDW/ProRail/transit and sector partners must separate mobility/supply routes from utility/facility topology and provide only safe aggregate service interfaces where releasable.
